records.jp: 盛り上がってますかー！！
records.en_original: How's everybody feeling tonight?!
records.en_auxiliary: How's everybody feeling tonight?!
records.en: How's everybody feeling tonight?!

records.jp: おおー
records.en_original: Yeaaahh!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeaaahh!
records.en: Yeaaahh!

records.jp: みんなー！<CR>今日はあたしのライブに集まってくれてありがとー！

records.en_auxiliary: Thank you all for coming to my show!
records.en: Thank<CR>you all for coming to my show!

records.jp: きゃー！　勇希ちゃーん！
records.en_original: Whoooo! We love you, Yuki!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoooo! We love you, Yuki!
records.en: Whoooo! We love you, Yuki!

records.en_original: Whoa, looks like we've got a passionate fan in the house! I better put on a good show for you!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, looks like we've got a passionate fan in the house! I better put on a good show for you!
records.en: Whoa, looks like we've got a passionate<CR>fan! Then Yuki-chan might work even harder than usual!

records.jp: ふふっ、楽しそうだね
records.en_original: Hehe, you sure are having fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you sure are having fun.
records.en: Hehe, you sure are having fun.

records.jp: そういう設定なんだ
records.en_original: Oh, is that what you were going for?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, is that what you were going for?
records.en: Oh, is that what you were going for?

records.jp: ちょっとー！　設定とか言っちゃいけないんだよ！<CR>もっとノらないと！　こういう時は！
records.en_original: Hey, don't call me out like that! C'mon, you have to play along!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, don't call me out like that! C'mon, you have to play along!
records.en: Hey, don't call me out like that! C'mon,<CR>you have to play along!

records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... I think you're playing enough for the both of us, Yuki.
records.en: Ahaha... I think you're playing enough for the both of us, Yuki.

records.jp: こういうのはね、楽しんだもの勝ちなんだよ。<CR>恥ずかしがってたらもったいないでしょ？
records.en_original: Having fun is the most important thing in life. You can't let embarrassment get in the way of that!
records.en_auxiliary: Having fun is the most important thing in life. You can't let embarrassment get in the way of that!

records.jp: そう、なのかなぁ？
records.en_original: Is that so?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that so?
records.en: Is that so?

records.jp: あ、そうだ！
records.en_original: Ah, that reminds me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, that reminds me!
records.en: Ah, that reminds me!

records.jp: せっかくだし愛央も上がってみなよ！<CR>ここから見る景色、結構いいもんだよ？
records.en_original: Come on up, Ao! The view from up here is pretty great!
records.en_auxiliary: Come on up, Ao! The view from up here is pretty great!
records.en: Come on up, Ao! The view<CR>from up here is pretty great!

records.en_original: May I have this dance, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: May I have this dance, Ao?
records.en: May I have this dance, Ao-san?

records.jp: そこまで言うなら、やってみようかな
records.en_original: Well since you asked so nicely, sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Well since you asked so nicely, sure.
records.en: Well since you asked so nicely, sure.

records.jp: おお、いいね～！　さ、こっち来て！
records.en_original: Yesss! Well then, right this way!
records.en_auxiliary: Yesss! Well then, right this way!
records.en: Yesss! Well then, right this way!

records.jp: は、恥ずかしいよ……
records.en_original: I-I don't dance...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I don't dance...
records.en: I-I don't dance...

records.en_auxiliary: Aw, it's okay, no one's watching! Come on, join me?

records.en_auxiliary: O-okay...
records.en: O-okay...

records.en_auxiliary: Whew, am I beat! How was it, Ao?
records.en: Whew, am I beat!<CR>How was it, Ao?

records.jp: やっぱりちょっと恥ずかしかった、かな……
records.en_original: A little embarrassing, to be honest...
records.en_auxiliary: A little embarrassing, to be honest...
records.en: A little embarrassing, to be honest...

records.en_auxiliary: Really? I didn't know you were so shy, Ao!
records.en: Really? I didn't know you were so shy, Ao!

records.jp: い、いいじゃん別に！<CR>私は勇希みたいに器用じゃないんだよ

records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what's wrong with that?! I'm not as graceful as you...

records.en_original: Hehe, no need to get so worked up. You were adorable.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, no need to get so worked up. You were adorable.

records.jp: ストレス発散になった！<CR>やっぱ体を動かすのっていいね～
records.en_original: I feel way less stressed now! It really does help to get some exercise every once in a while, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: I feel way less stressed now! It really does help to get some exercise every once in a while, huh?

records.jp: ふふ、でしょ？<CR>あたしは学校に残ってるから特にね～

records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, right? Especially me, since I always stay at the school while you're off exploring.

records.jp: あ、もしかして、ちょっと踊りが上手かったのって<CR>一人でコソ練してたからとか……？
